title: The batch door's string caps are named by batchProblem before pricing
body:
## Summary
The batch door's string caps are named by batchProblem before pricing

## Description
acts.ts's zod form caps 10 string fields (prompt 2000, negative 1000, genre/mood/instrument 400, event/material/space 300, sfxCategory 80, key 40) that packages/ui/src/components/audio/batch.ts batchProblem never checks, so an over-length field passes the client (no badge on Price) and is refused by the door as a zod error. Fix: export BATCH_LIMITS from batch.ts, check them in batchProblem (the server re-runs it in lib/sound/batch.ts), and have acts.ts build its zod caps from the same constant.

## Flow
- build the instrument named below, seed it red on HEAD
- apply the fix in the out-of-scope file, re-measure

## Expected impact
The client form and the server door agree on one figure; a worker owning app/(studio)/audio can land it. Could break: a door test pinning the literal.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - The batch door's string caps are named by batchProblem before pricing
Before: 0 of 10 door caps named by the client form
After: 10 of 10, one constant read by both
Method: simulation - the seam is in app/(studio)/audio/_insight/acts.ts, outside this context's paths (veto 1)
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: vitest case: batchProblem over a 41-char key / 2001-char prompt returns a field word; a source ratchet that acts.ts holds no numeric .max literal for those fields

title: dcbf3e4b carries the case-dedupe fix under the tempo commit's subject
body:
## Summary
Commit dcbf3e4b (recipe.ts holds/addTo case-insensitive) landed with the message of 52f45e3e.

## Description
In a gate chain the commit message heredoc sat after a `&&` link that failed (a sibling's stale mutant-registry entry for lib/decision/v1/sources/proof.ts), so the message file was not rewritten while the `git add/commit` after a newline still ran. The code in it is the case-dedupe fix and is green (audio.test 20/20 at the time); only the subject is wrong. No amend is allowed; the operator may reword before pushing.

## Flow
- git show dcbf3e4b

## Expected impact
History reads two commits with one subject.

## Evaluation
Claim: other - history accuracy
Before: 2 commits share a subject
After: reworded by the operator
Method: probe - git log
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: irreversible
